decisions.reason: 몰골 is wretched physical appearance; “shape” keeps that, while “state”/“replied” are mere synonym swaps.
그렇죠 after 그치? is casual confirmation; “Right.” matches that pair better than stiff “It is.”
SOL captures 일장 and habitual 눈만 감으면 but turns the attack into “they,” 생각났다 into “saw,” and 따라다닐 악몽 into haunting nightmares.
decisions.replacement: A single palm strike from Jopil. An attack you couldn’t block even if you knew it was coming. Whenever Hyuk Mujin closed his eyes, that bastard’s red-hot palm came back to him. It might become a nightmare that followed him for the rest of his life.

decisions.reason: 한엽의 목소리 specifies his voice; “sounded calm” drops that detail for no gain.
입을 다물었다 is shutting his mouth, not falling silent; SOL also adds unsupported “real” and “exactly.”
SOL restores 으로도/표현 but drops 스스로의; keep “even…to describe it” and “own.”
decisions.replacement: Even *overwhelming* wasn’t enough to describe it. All his effort, all his pride in his own martial arts, had been ripped up by the roots.

decisions.reason: 별로 어렵지도 is “not particularly hard”; SOL’s “wasn’t even hard” overstates.
“continued” is only a synonym of 말을 이었다; no prose gain.
그 생각을 하니까 is thinking that thought, not “once I started thinking that way.”
변했구나. 이 녀석도. is two beats; SOL collapses “You too.”
SOL misidentifies the timid second-rate as Hyuk; BASE keeps the right subject but misses 동참 and 문득 울렁거렸다.
decisions.replacement: Even the timid second-rate martial artist had, before anyone noticed, joined that current. Hyuk Mujin felt his heart suddenly surge. The next words burst out before he could stop them.

decisions.reason: 눈을 동그랗게 뜬 is eyes going round; “widened” loses the round-eyed surprise.
Split off the 동시에 line, but SOL’s insert drops 동시에.
decisions.replacement: They thought of the same person at the same time.

decisions.reason: Isolating 진태경. matches the source’s standalone name beat.
Name moved to H014, but 뛰고 is running, not racing.
decisions.replacement: He was already running far ahead of them. What was he doing now?

decisions.reason: “left ajar” is the natural door collocation for 빠끔히 열려 있던 without changing the action.
Participle matches simultaneous 돌아서는데 better than sequential “and.”
아주 가관이다, 가관 is deliberate repetition; SOL flattens the second 가관.
“gone through life and death” is the natural rendering of 생사고락을 함께한; “shared” calques 함께한.
부상자로 가문에 잔류 is remaining as wounded, not recovering at an “estate.”
“meeting” captures 달성, which BASE’s “close to the last condition” leaves implicit.
말년 병장 is a sergeant in his last stretch; “nearing discharge” drops 말년.
Clipped “no need” matches the thought’s 굳이 알릴 필요 없이; “there’s” is padding.
쓱 훑어보고 is a once-over, not a sick visit; SOL also completes the interrupted 들르면……
자마자 plus 즉각적인 is “the moment” and “at once”; SOL drops the second immediacy.
은혜를 입었습니다 is receiving a kindness; SOL substitutes generic “what you’ve done for us.”
오라버니 to Socheon is “Big brother,” and 입었어 is past “put on,” not present “wearing.”
그거 옷 아냐 is the 입다 clothes realization (“that’s clothes, isn’t it?”); SOL inverts it.
공치사 들으려고 is doing it for praise; BASE’s “hear you flatter me” adds a flattery charge.
쫓기던 is ongoing pursuit; 남기를 원했다 is wanting to stay, not “be left behind.”
BASE’s “the decision I reached was” is translationese; SOL’s “agonizing” thins 수많은 갈등.
decisions.replacement: After a great deal of inner conflict, I decided to go back for him.

decisions.reason: 안다고 봐야 한다 is an inference (“must already know”), not a flat “already knew.”
따로 없겠군 means we wouldn’t need a separate loudspeaker; SOL has them setting one up.
이대로 is “like this”; SOL drops the point of the worry.
휘휘 저어 is waving the thought away, not shaking it off.
BASE gives the proverb naturally; SOL’s “had no feet, yet” is calqued.
슬쩍 열어 is cracking the window open; SOL flattens it to a plain open.
“practically a done deal” matches 기정사실이나 마찬가지 in Taekyung’s register.
듣다가 marks listening for some time before rising; BASE skips that duration.
제지한 건 공야청이었다 is a cleft; SOL’s “but” flattens that emphasis.
갈 땐 가더라도 is “you may be leaving, but”; SOL adds unsupported “must.”
물건이요 echoes “the thing”; “What I left behind?” drops 물건.
손이 가벼운 is empty-handed, which sets up the heavy bundle; “traveled light” loses 손.
“at the time” locates 경황이 없어 in the past chaos; “is here” is natural for 왔으니.
받아 들었다 is physically taking the bundle; “accepted” turns it ceremonial.
비할 바가 아니다 means worth far more, and “their value” matches 이 물건들의 가치.
수많은 피 is countless blood and 오랜 시간 a long time; SOL weakens both and over-specifies “years.”
Dropping the comma before “but that” fixes the relative-clause grammar.
이런 물건 is “things like these”; SOL upgrades them to “treasures.”
주더라 is “gives”; “hands over” is a needless synonym.
SOL’s 망겜 is good, but “coughing it up” misses 뒷북; keep catch-up lateness with the stronger game insult.
decisions.replacement: Goddamn trash game. If it was going to give me something, it should’ve done it sooner. Playing catch-up after everything was finished just spiked my blood pressure.

decisions.reason: 나도 모르게 혹할 is catching himself being tempted; SOL’s “just…enough” drops that.
말년 and 잘못 삼켰다가 are last-stretch and swallowing wrong; SOL flattens both.
넙죽 is gulping it down readily; “on the spot” changes manner to timing.
훅 가는 is “gone”; “done for” is only a synonym.
Matches 약속된 날짜와 장소다 and naturalizes 시간을 어기는 법이 없었다; 어둠 속 ‘그’ is the man in the darkness.
참 좋았는데 includes “really”; SOL drops 참.
없었으면 좋겠다 is “I wished there were no moon,” not preference (“rather”).
밤 생활이라 still tracks “living at night”; compounding to “Nightlife” jumps to the gigolo reading early.
떠벌리다 is running his mouth, and 기둥서방처럼 is “like” a kept man; “prattled”/“tone of” weaken both.
끝났지 is “finished”; “complete” is a mere synonym.
냄새를 맡으면 is a whiff of this work, and 일이 틀어지다 is things going wrong, not the whole plan falling apart.
어련할까 is wry “as if it would be otherwise,” not a flat “Of course.”
The fog-stirring is a generic metaphor (“you”); SOL’s “he” over-personalizes, and under/beneath is churn.
Two 로 complements (가주로, 패자로) read cleaner as “and the sole hegemon”; remaining sentences move to H066.
Separate 야망이다 beat; “harbored” fits 간직한 better than “held.”
양분하는 is dividing Shanxi between the two sects; BASE omits that split.
